rules.timezone: Saudi Arabia UTC+03:00; day boundary 21:00 UTC
rules.quote: Dukascopy XAUUSD BID (not live MT5 broker quote)
rules.reset: Independent touch only after price closes at least 3 or 5 USD away, minimum 5 minutes separation
rules.approach: Resistance approached from below, support approached from above; state known before touch
rules.bounce: Within next 5/15/30/60 min: $3 in rejection direction before $2 against = reject_3_first
rules.break_rule: Within next 5/15/30/60 min: $2 adverse before $3 favorable = break_2_first
rules.incomplete: Insufficient future data not counted as success/failure
rules.ambiguity: Both thresholds in same minute classified ambiguous
rules.wick: M5/M15 bearish/bullish wick >= 1.5x candle body and candle closes back on approach side
rules.htf_pivots: Strict k=3 H1, k=2 H4, k=2 M15 pivots confirmed only after right bars close
rules.volume: This Dukascopy download omits volume; any missing volume metric is null. No COMEX/order book volume is available.

caveats: Price 3868.30 is not a point with infinite precision; broker spreads, liquidity and volatility create zones.
Multiple retests of one level are not independent statistical samples.
A resistance may flip to support after a confirmed break; count both separately.
No order book, resting orders, institutional positioning, or actual MT5 broker spread in this data.
If most recent Dukascopy candle is earlier than current time, today's study is incomplete.
Observed historical reactions cannot guarantee the next reaction.
